name: fortunetellers-hand
description: An MCP server that runs The Fortuneteller's Hand — a tabletop RPG by Maria Saha. This is the solo journaling RPG version where you create a narrative with Claude running the table, casting Omens and reading the cards.

tools.name: draw_cross_card
tools.description: Draw a card for the Sitting's cross, blind, from the given suit's pile, into the given position.

tools.name: draw_goal_card
tools.description: Deal the Goal: reshuffle what's left of fate's deck and draw one card face up.

tools.name: name_character
tools.description: Name the character being created at the Sitting.

tools.name: record_goal_interpretation
tools.description: Save what the Goal actually means, once the player's answered and it's been reflected back.

tools.name: cast_omen
tools.description: Cast an omen: roll two d10 (light and dark), compare — never sum — and read the result.

tools.name: call_the_hand
tools.description: Doubles trigger: play the table-wide ripest debt card, or deal a fresh card from the Fortuneteller's Hand deck if every row is clean.

tools.name: defy_roll
tools.description: Roll the defiance dice, keeping any values specified from the current dice, up to three rolls total.

tools.name: defy_resolve
tools.description: Lock in the current dice as final, deal one debt card per roll taken, and reset the ritual.

tools.name: draw_unclaimed_card
tools.description: Flip a card from the Fortuneteller's Hand for the Unclaimed: read cold, before any narration.

tools.name: get_sheet
tools.description: A player's current cross and debt row.
